description: Fungal infection is a skin disease caused by fungi that thrive in warm and moist environments.
An allergy is an immune system response to a foreign substance that is typically not harmful.
Gastroesophageal reflux disease is a digestive disorder affecting the lower esophageal sphincter.
Chronic cholestasis is a condition where bile flow from the liver is reduced or blocked.
A drug reaction is an unwanted or harmful reaction experienced after the administration of a medication.
Peptic ulcer disease refers to open sores that develop on the inner lining of the stomach.
